items.q: Is LinkedIn data fetched via API?
items.a: No. LinkedIn API doesn't provide profile data to third parties. Profile info is self-declared by the candidate, verified via LinkedIn OAuth (name, photo, profile URL).
Not by default. You can record locally in your browser (MediaRecorder). Media never touches our servers — it's peer-to-peer WebRTC.
Only STUN by default. Symmetric NAT may need TURN — configure TURN_URL, TURN_USERNAME, TURN_CREDENTIAL env vars.

items.q: Can I use it without LinkedIn?
items.a: Yes, demo login works without LinkedIn OAuth.
